summary: The existing future-only apparatus derives a closed source manifest after the existing authenticated bootstrap/instrumentation checks and before store creation or tracer launch. Exact selected Python executable, libpython, zlib extension, libz and tracer pins join their declared read allowlist and directory entries; libz alias/target and three glibc-hwcaps misses join their original directory/ancestor identities. A canonical digest binds the complete declared inventory, not just the five minimum roles. Both existing bootstrap evidence and authority must carry the exact derived manifest and retain the existing candidateSupportPins/readEvidence joins. The domain-separated closure digest travels through the held store context and existing one-use measured handshake; changed or downgraded contexts refuse and each context recomputes the join rather than caching observations. Lower-level unbound codec/parser fixtures cannot satisfy the measured handshake. The source case pins strace7.2 release source/archive and fixed named-FIFO follower output: the tracer opens its output, marks it close-on-exec and closes it in the pre-exec subject; no shell, compressor actor or inherited original trace-writer FD is introduced. This is additional prospective source reasoning, not promotion of the old instrumentation boundary or observed tracer FIFO/backpressure support. Unsampled probe identity/lifetime/peak unknowns and early-abort holds remain. Actual source controls exercise role/inventory/manifests, refusal before store/launch, handshake downgrade, per-use digest drift and the existing FIFO/parser/clock/first-cause/cleanup joins using inert process/kernel adapters. The raw preflight, bootstrap/read-drift/capacity validators, instrumentation constants, sourceOnly profile and maximum4 remain unchanged. Historical retained bytes can derive this source manifest but historical inode identities/clocks are not fresh bootstrap evidence. A future enforcing runtime profile still needs selected exact current source/runtime/bootstrap inventory, actual capacity, finite clocks/representation and the existing root-owned admission/consumed-ordinal disposition. No actual tracer/client/native/App operation, package publication, installed consumer adoption or release of historical Unknown holds follows. Source-closure correspondence is not proof that every future runtime read or complete stream has been observed.
title: Prospective trace profile binds declared runtime and complete inventory before capture
